U2NETP — local salient-object segmentation model

Original authors: Xuebin Qin and contributors, U-2-Net.
Official project: https://github.com/xuebinqin/U-2-Net
Original project license: Apache License 2.0 (U2NET-LICENSE).

ONNX conversion distributed by rembg (Daniel Gatis and contributors, MIT).
Download: https://github.com/danielgatis/rembg/releases/download/v0.0.0/u2netp.onnx
Upstream checksum: MD5 8e83ca70e441ab06c318d82300c84806
Reference session: https://github.com/danielgatis/rembg/blob/main/rembg/sessions/u2netp.py
Reference normalization: https://github.com/danielgatis/rembg/blob/main/rembg/sessions/base.py

The model is bundled locally. Photos are processed on the user's device.
It is a general foreground model, not trained specifically for metrological tool tracing.
The 320x320 prediction requires high-resolution edge refinement and scale verification.
